paper_title: Counting Euler Tours in Undirected Bounded Treewidth Graphs
statement: Can the #SAC1 bound be improved, to say, GapL or Logspace? How far can the Euler tour result be extended? To bounded clique-width graphs? Chordal graphs? Can the determinant of bounded clique-width adjacency matrices be computed in better than #SAC1 ? (it is known to be L-hard even for bounded tree-width graphs from [6]).
